name: Sampled-values stream quality gate
summary: Uses the assigned stream-quality information before accepting the selected measurement data.
description: Uses the assigned stream-quality information before accepting the selected measurement data. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Measurement and quality flags” at the input and “Accepted measurement state” at the output. Invalidity handling must be explicitly configured.
